```python
import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample data
data = {
    "store": ["A", "B", "A", "B", "C"],
    "revenue": [100, 200, 150, 250, 300],
    "items": [10, 20, 15, 25, 30]
}
df = nw.from_native(pd.DataFrame(data))

# Group by store and aggregate
result = df.group_by("store").agg(
    revenue_sum=nw.col("revenue").sum(),
    items_mean=nw.col("items").mean()
).sort("store")

print(result)
```
